messages:
maya (oncall): apiserver 503s in eu-west2 started at ~1745678850, backlog of attach requests piling up. seeing a spike in etcd wal sync latency and apiserver fd exhaustion.
lin (infra): grabbing etcd host metrics now. NVMe queue depth and iowait are elevated on etcd-1. can someone drop the recent logs?
maya (oncall): logs paste:
```
2024-06-14T15:47:20.112Z etcdserver: wal sync took 1.02s
2024-06-14T15:47:20.315Z apiserver: http: response 503 POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods
2024-06-14T15:47:21.001Z provisioner: attach queued instance-gpu-07
2024-06-14T15:47:22.002Z etcdserver: store/index: compacted 1000 revisions, paused writes
```
owen (platform): controller-manager leader election had a timeout at 15:47:23 but leader re-elected within 300ms. leader churn minimal but pod churn from GPU onboarding is heavy.
lin (infra): quick mitigation: reducing provisioner max_concurrent_attaches in eu-west2 from 120 -> 35 (canary) to throttle attach burst. applying patch to configmap infra/provisioner-config.
maya (oncall): also scaling apiserver replicas from 3->6 in eu-west2 to spread client fds. watching error rate.
owen (platform): added a temporary smart-route to direct non-write apiserver traffic (/metrics, /healthz, read-only list ops) to eu-west1 for 10m to reduce pressure on the unhealthy etcd leader. ensure no leader-only operations are routed.
lin (infra): initial telemetry: after throttle + scale, 503s dropped ~60% in first 90s. etcd wal sync lat p95 dropped from 1.02s -> 220ms. NVMe queue depth reduced.
maya (oncall): good. next steps: repro in staging with synthetic onboarding bursts, run fio on etcd WAL volume to validate iops, consider moving WAL to dedicated throughput-optimized volume or using writeback cache.
owen (platform): plus: add jitter and windowed batching to onboarding controller. small change: add 50-200ms random delay before Pod create and group attaches into 10s windows.
lin (infra): opening INF-4954 to track storage perf testing + potential disk migration and to coordinate with storage team. tagging provisioning and platform.
ops-bot: incident INC-2024-1201 created (severity: medium) assigned to eng-sre.
maya (oncall): leaving watch, will update postmortem if stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:

(Notes packed in incident: cost impact from scaling extra apiserver replicas + potential dedicated disk pricing; list of follow-ups: staging repro, fio runs, provisioner jitter, etcd compaction tuning)
